notes.title: Colourblind - Final Days
notes.content:
Hello there!

[h1]This will be the last update before the ultimate launch of Colourblind! [/h1]

If you would like a video version of development so far, watch my devlog on my youtube channel

[previewyoutube=-mNcQaTkUQ4;full]https://youtu.be/-mNcQaTkUQ4[/previewyoutube]

Colourblind has been a rough journey due to some minor setbacks, I never though I would be uploading a game onto Steam! Colourblind has always been a passion project of mine and i am so happy to be releasing it soon on 12th September 2023.

If you didn't know, Colourblind is a 3D Puzzle Game about manipulating Colour to solve puzzles and activate machines to unveil a story about robots in a post-apocalyptic world. In a world where all Colour has dissipated, and all that is left are the Coloured "Coreium cubes", you must team up with your fellow robot companions to escape the world.

Colourblind is inspired by the robotic atmosphere and physics-based puzzles of Portal, the innovative gameplay of Half-Life 2 and the simplistic artstyle of Antichamber and Manifold Garden.

Now, the end is near and Colourblind will be released soon!


A few things I would like to say,

[olist]
[*] Thanks to the Kickstarter backers for making this possible (through emotional support lol)
[*] Once the game is released, I will not be updating the game until November due to a lack of time because of Studies.
[*] There will be a competition being hosted where the fastest person to complete Colourblind by the end of October will be dubbed "An epic gamer"
[/olist]


Thanks for listening, wish you a good day and hope you enjoy Colourblind!

notes.title: NEW PUZZLE MECHANIC: Lasers!
notes.content:
Hello! Development on Colourblind is about [b]70% Finished[/b]! There is still polishing up Chapter 4 and the level designs of Chapter 5 to be done!

Having said that, Development on Chapter 4 is currently underway! This Chapter's new puzzle mechanic is the Laser!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479303/f5afd3f5ab2503def2a9483c653ea2c1dee49cdb.png[/img]

These deadly lasers will evaporate you in an instant! Thus, you will need to find ways to block said lasers to progress! However, there is a special system in place for this puzzle mechanic!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479303/19c1a89d748c7c9d69e4fa2f1e0a38d37716b1bf.png[/img]

In the screenshot above, different lasers have different colours. Each coloured laser can only be blocked by a Coreium Cube of the same colour! 

For eg. Blue lasers can only be blocked by blue Coreium cubes, the laser will pass right through other cubes such as red and yellow.

This opens up many possible puzzle designs that should make Chapter 4 fun to play!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479303/275fd65491b718de0e4584a92b0b94587eacf58a.png[/img]

notes.title: CHAPTER 3 Almost done! Graphics Improvements!
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome to the [b]First [/b]Update of Colourblind! ːsteamhappyː[/h1]

There have been major changes to the game so I will list them here:
[olist]
[*]Upgrading Graphics
[*]Improving Outline Effect
[*]More options in settings
[*]Chapter 3's Development
[*]Chapter 4's Pre-Development
[*]Chapter 2's Remake
[/olist]
[h2]GRAPHICS[/h2]

Colourblind has recently upgraded from Unity's URP (Universal Render Pipeline) to HDRP (High Definition Render Pipeline), which allows for less restrictions on lighting and generally gives the game a better look! The reduction in lighting restrictions also gave way for various opportunities to create better visual effects, such as the enhanced [b]Outlining [/b]effect!

Here are some screenshots to demonstrate:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479303/32352960d1e7a2a0acff7058c486cadd86216e28.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479303/d4fcbc4229acecd6f1a446ddce315a9b0632b190.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43479303/41fe9beae320156d1e421788feb6f9d37e0dda67.png[/img]

However, this does come with its own [b]problems[/b], the [b]performance [/b]is an example. The frame rate might decrease to support the graphics, so I might add an [i]option [/i]to lower the graphics and improve the performance!

[h2]MORE OPTIONS IN SETTINGS[/h2]

One of the backers of the project over at kickstarter.com also suggested to me that [b]more settings[/b] options to cater to different player's preferences, so say no more! Some options will include:
[list]
[*] Inverted X and Y Axis
[*] Graphics options
[*] Crosshair disabling
[*] Captions disabling
[/list]

[h2]CHAPTERS?[/h2]

Out of all the chapters, I personally think Chapter 3 has been the simplest to make so far!
If you do not know, Chapter 3 takes place in a cave, where you try to escape while evil [i](but dumb) [/i] robots try to hunt you down and [strike]murder[/strike] befriend you!

I would say Chapter 3 is a good [b]75% finished[/b], I still have yet to incorporate the voice actors in the game, as well as a [b][i]final boss battle[/i][/b]???

However, I have long been dissatisfied with how Chapter 2 was designed. Thus, I will be remaking Chapter 2 almost entirely! So expect a delay here and there. Hope you understand!

[h2]WHAT ABOUT CHAPTER 4???[/h2]

I already have plans and the script written out for Chapter 4! It will introduce a [b]Bumbling new Character[/b] that guides you through a rather [i]mechanical [/i]chapter of the game...

[h2]WHAT ABOUT CHAPTER 5???[/h2]
Woah, slow down there partner

I have just started writing the script of chapter 5, and I promise, [b]Chapter 5 will be crazy[/b]

Anyways, that's all the time I have!

[h1]WISHLIST COLOURBLIND ON STEAM NOW[/h1]
